import_csv.title: Import events from CSV
import_csv.description:
Columns: name, type, day, month, year (optional), icon (optional), vip (optional). `type` must be one of: birthday, anniversary, name_day, wedding_anniversary, memorial, pet_birthday, work_anniversary, custom (always in English, regardless of your language setting). `vip` accepts 1/true/yes/y/x (case-insensitive); leave it empty or omit the column for a non-VIP event. Keep every column even when a value is empty - a row with a missing trailing comma shifts the following values left. Invalid rows are skipped and logged.

Example:
```
name,type,day,month,year,icon,vip
Anna,birthday,12,4,1988,,
Max,pet_birthday,3,9,2020,mdi:dog,
Test Custom,custom,1,1,,mdi:test-tube,1
```

import_holidays.title: Import holidays
import_holidays.description: Pick a country to import its holidays as events. Re-running this later for the same country (and subdivision) updates the existing entries instead of creating duplicates - safe to repeat if a country adds a new holiday.

import_holidays_options.title: Import holidays - {country}
import_holidays_options.description: Leave the subdivision empty for national holidays only - a state/province adds its own regional holidays on top. Categories and language depend on what this country's holiday data provides. Multi-day categories like school holidays are represented as one event on their first day.

remove_holidays.title: Remove imported holidays
remove_holidays.description: {total} holiday event(s) currently imported. Check the box below to remove all of them, or leave it unchecked and pick one batch instead. Manually added events are never affected.

annual_settings.title: Annual Settings
annual_settings.description: Comma-separated occurrence numbers that get an event automatically marked "Important" for that event type, e.g. "18,21,30,40,50". Leave a field empty to disable this for that type.

delete_all.title: Delete all Annuals data
delete_all.description: This permanently deletes all {count} event(s), the shared calendars, and the Annuals hub itself - the entire integration and everything it created. This cannot be undone. Click OK to confirm.
